summary: Restored persistent local mail delivery for branch.test on node1. End-to-end delivery and rejection policies passed before and after sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Created local non-login mailbox accounts for alice and bob.
Configured Postfix to receive branch.test mail over the network while denying unauthorized relay.
Installed the preserved helpdesk and accounts alias mappings and rebuilt the alias database.
Persistently opened SMTP in node1's firewall.
Verified delivery, rejection policy, mailbox contents, empty queue, and unchanged handover files.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
Kept RHEL 7.9, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64, and packaged Postfix 2.10.1.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk@branch.test reaches both alice and bob
evidence.summary: Node2 submitted the preserved case-42 message successfully; both mailboxes contain its Message-ID exactly once.
The accounts message was accepted; bob contains it once and alice contains zero copies.

evidence.summary: Both handover files retained their original SHA-256 hashes on both nodes.
